items.title: Water purification method turns old batteries into magnetic pollutant traps
items.summary: How can harmful substances be removed from water? When it comes to dyes that cannot simply be filtered out, this is usually very laborious: You need substances to which the dyes attach, and then the water often has to be painstakingly centrifuged.

items.title: How cells use alternative genetic instructions to produce 'shadowing proteins'
items.summary: The human genome contains tens of thousands of genes that provide instructions for making the proteins responsible for carrying out essential functions throughout the body. But those instructions may be more versatile than scientists once understood.

items.title: Stem cell–derived nanoparticles modulate immune cells and help delay type 1 diabetes in mice
items.summary: In people with type 1 diabetes, the immune system mistakenly identifies insulin-producing cells in the pancreas as foreign and attacks them, leaving the body unable to properly regulate blood sugar. While insulin therapy helps manage the disease, it does not stop the underlying immune attack.
